_note: Researched 23 Nov 2026 from third-party pages quoting the CGL 2026 notification (21 May 2026). Always verify on ssc.gov.in.
language: English (Hindi not simulated). Tier-I questions are bilingual in the real exam, except English Comprehension.

test1.name: Test-1 (Tier-I)
test1.role: Screening only, not counted in final merit

test2.name: Test-2 (Tier-II) Paper-I
test2.role: Decides merit. Paper-I Sections I+II = 390 marks (this is what ASO MEA is ranked on)

otherPapers: Paper-II Statistics (JSO/SI only) and Paper-III Finance & Economics (AAO/AAcO only, new in 2026) are not needed for ASO MEA. Section IV Data Entry Speed Test (15 min) is qualifying for some posts: check your notification.

asoMea.post: Assistant Section Officer, Ministry of External Affairs, post code B11 in CGL 2024
asoMea.education: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university
asoMea.posting: Starts at MEA HQ New Delhi; postings at missions abroad possible later
asoMea.selectionNote: Qualify Tier-I and Tier-II, put ASO MEA high in post preferences (preferences are final), clear document verification.

pastCutoff.caution: Third-party table (Adda247). CSS was 533.25 and IB 353.94 in the same table, so scales are not obviously comparable. Treat as a rough guide only.

timeline.cgl2026: Notification 21 May 2026. Tier-I 30 Sep to 30 Oct 2026. Result expected Nov 2026. Tier-II expected Dec 2026 or Jan 2027 (not officially scheduled as of 4 Nov 2026).
timeline.cgl2027: Notification and dates not announced as of Jul 2026. Planning estimate used by the app: Tier-I around Jul 2027, Tier-II around Dec 2027, based on the CGL 2026 cycle. Change it in Settings once SSC announces.
